⚖️ ELI5 Kata · A+A = B+B → A = B (Coq, 6 kyu)

Imagine two kids with identical twin stacks of LEGO bricks: Alice has A+A bricks and Bob has B+B. If their total towers are equal height, must A equal B?

Coq proof: https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/6kyu/a-plus-a-equals-b-plus-b

🧱 ELI5 Step 1 (Peeling 2 Bricks at a Time):

In Peano arithmetic, numbers are built from 0 and S ("one more brick").
If Alice has 0 bricks and Bob has at least 1 (`S b`), `0 = S (...)` is impossible (`discriminate H`)!
If both have 0, `0 = 0` (`reflexivity`)!

🔄 ELI5 Step 2 (The S(a)+S(a) Twist):

What if both have at least 1 brick (`S a` and `S b`)?
`(S a) + (S a)` simplifies on the left to `S (a + S a)`.
Our helper lemma `add_succ_r` pulls the second `S` out to the front: `S (S (a + a)) = S (S (b + b))`!

✅ Peeling off both outer `S` bricks (`inversion H`) gives `a + a = b + b`, so induction (`IHa`) seals it with 0 axioms!

Coq: https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/blob/main/katas/6kyu/a-plus-a-equals-b-plus-b/solution.v
